purpose: Teach: 鳳/鞘/英字/天秤/死語/有色/太もも/気密

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、鳳凰刺青の容疑者を、警察、追われてますね
lines.en: So in this case, the police are currently pursuing a suspect with a phoenix tattoo.
lines.style: Measured, thoughtful pace. Slight lean forward—gathering information, not instructing. Quiet conviction beneath the surface. Careful articulation on the case details.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、刀の鞘から指紋を採取されますね
lines.en: The police are collecting fingerprints from the sword's sheath.
lines.style: Professional, steady confirmation. Matter-of-fact delivery without coldness. Brief pause after opening phrase. Nods slightly with the factual precision.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、英字偽造証明書を、警察、扱われますね
lines.en: In this case, the police are handling the forged English-language documents.
lines.style: Measured, almost curious inflection. Building on the previous detail. Slight weight on 'handling'—acknowledging the scope of the investigation.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、天秤鑑識で正確さを保たれますね
lines.en: The police maintain accuracy through forensic balance analysis.
lines.style: Calm, authoritative. Each detail lands clearly. No rush. The tone of someone who trusts the procedure to speak for itself.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、死語化した暗号を、警察、解読されますね
lines.en: In this case, the police are decoding an obsolete cipher.
lines.style: Quiet intensity. Slight intrigue in the delivery—the complexity is real. Deliberate pace on technical terms. Leans in slightly with the revelation.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、有色人種への差別事件にも対応されますね
lines.en: The police are also handling cases involving discrimination against people of color.
lines.style: Shifts to seriousness. Slower pace. Direct eye contact. No performative gravity, but the weight is unmistakable. Slight firmness on 'also.'

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、太もも刺傷の鑑識を、警察、おこなわれますね
lines.en: In this case, the police are conducting forensic analysis of the thigh wound.
lines.style: Returns to clinical precision. Even tone. Respectful distance from the brutality—professional, not detached. Steady breath support throughout.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、気密性高い倉庫からの脱出事件も扱われますね
lines.en: The police are also handling the escape from an airtight storage facility.
lines.style: Final detail, grounded delivery. Slight emphasis on 'airtight'—the constraint matters. Closes with quiet authority. Breath steady, no trailing.
